detail.longDescription: Am I micromanaging my AI agents? I'm building Jasper, a Ruby-like programming language, with AI agents. So I checked my sessions. During implementation, only 4 of my 19 messages corrected something. The problem was an agent that followed my instructions too well. It merged an unchecked research spike to main, three times. My instructions never said that a spike is different from a feature.
